rejections.rationale: The positive describes a selectable cache-block-size value, while the contrast describes a cross-hart uniformity constraint rather than a numeric choice. Encoding both as direct_value would mislabel the constraint; encoding the contrast as other would add choice_object as a third discriminating axis and would not form a clean minimal contrast.

The frozen H1 authority classifies NEG_FIXED_ENCODING as not_surfaced with null parameter status, while the Phase 3 pair schema permits only accept or classify_out. Relabeling it as classify_out would rewrite approved H1 semantics.
